statements.english: Look what you did with your funny , funny form
statements.chinese: 看看你用你那滑稽可笑的表格都干了些什么。

statements.english: What ? Me ?
statements.chinese: 什么？我？

statements.english: What about you and your " consummated like bunnies " nonsense ?
statements.chinese: 那你和你那套"像兔子一样完事"的胡扯又算什么？

statements.english: What are you typing that for ?
statements.chinese: 你打这个是为了什么？

statements.english: She said we don't get the annulment
statements.chinese: 她说我们无法撤销婚姻。

statements.english: Don't type that . What- -
statements.chinese: 别打那个。什么——

statements.english: Stop typing !
statements.chinese: 别打字了！

statements.english: Stop typing !
statements.chinese: 停止输入！

statements.english: " Stop typing , stop typing !"
statements.chinese: 别打字了，别打字了！

statements.english: Okay , do you see what you're keeping me married to ?
statements.chinese: 好吧，你明白你让我维系的是怎样的婚姻吗？

statements.english: You need to get out of my chambers
statements.chinese: 请你离开我的房间。

statements.english: Look , lady , here's the deal
statements.chinese: 听着，女士，事情是这样的。

statements.english: l came here for an annulment
statements.chinese: 我来这是为了解除婚姻关系

statements.english: and l'm not leaving here until l get one !
statements.chinese: 不得到一个我绝不离开这里！

statements.english: Would you like a night in jail ?
statements.chinese: 你想在监狱里过夜吗？

statements.english: Thank you for your time
statements.chinese: 感谢您抽出时间。

statements.english: That Porsche guy took his car back
statements.chinese: 那个开保时捷的家伙把他的车开回去了。

statements.english: But you found the keys to his clothes ?
statements.chinese: 但你找到他衣服的钥匙了？

statements.english: No , l just love the way it feels
statements.chinese: 不，我只是喜欢这种感觉

statements.english: when everybody thinks l own a Porsche
statements.chinese: 当所有人都以为我拥有一辆保时捷时。

thinks.definition: think（第三人称单数）: 认为

statements.english: And people will think you own a Porsche
statements.chinese: 人们会以为你拥有一辆保时捷

statements.english: - because you're wearing the clothes ? - Of Course !
statements.chinese: - 是因为你穿着这些衣服吗？ - 当然啦！

statements.english: Only an idiot would wear this stuff if he didn't have the car
statements.chinese: 除非有这辆车，否则只有傻瓜才会穿这身行头。

statements.english: That is true
statements.chinese: 确实如此。

statements.english: Yeah , but only a genius would swallow a sonic blaster gun
statements.chinese: 是啊，但只有天才才会吞下音波爆破枪。

statements.english: Oh , l've been there
statements.chinese: 哦，我去过那里。

been.definition: be（过去分词）: 构成现在完成时

statements.english: l am gonna go drive my Porsche
statements.chinese: 我要去开我的保时捷了。

statements.english: Joey , you know you don't actually have one
statements.chinese: Joey，你知道你其实并没有。

statements.english: Come on , what are you doing ? l'm in character
statements.chinese: 拜托，你在干嘛？我正在角色扮演中。

statements.english: Will you talk to her ?
statements.chinese: 你会和她谈谈吗？

statements.english: l think it just moved . lt's poking me
statements.chinese: 我觉得它刚才动了，正戳着我呢。

statements.english: All right , that's it , we're going to the emergency room
statements.chinese: 好了，就这样吧，我们得去急诊室了。

statements.english: No , you can't leave me here with them
statements.chinese: 不，你不能把我一个人丢在这里和他们在一起。

statements.english: We're babysitting
statements.chinese: 我们在照看孩子。

babysitting.definition: babysit（现在分词）: 照看孩子

statements.english: The babies are asleep
statements.chinese: 宝宝们睡着了。

statements.english: I'm sure you'll be okay on your own
statements.chinese: 我相信你自己能行的。

statements.english: But you can't leave me with them
statements.chinese: 但你不能把我丢给他们。

statements.english: We're a team
statements.chinese: 我们是一个团队。

statements.english: We're playing a zone . They'll triple-team me !
statements.chinese: 我们在打联防。他们会三人包夹我！

statements.english: He's got something plastic lodged in his throat
statements.chinese: 他喉咙里卡了一块塑料。

statements.english: we've got to go to the hospital
statements.chinese: 我们得去医院了。

statements.english: But a doctor won't be able to help him
statements.chinese: 但医生帮不了他。

be.definition: 构成进行时或被动语态

statements.english: And it's just gonna ... you know
statements.chinese: 而且它只是...你知道的，

statements.english: ... naturally pass through his system in seven years
statements.chinese: 自然会在七年内通过他的身体系统排出。

statements.english: - l think that's gum . - l'm pretty sure it's gun
statements.chinese: - 我觉得那是口香糖。- 我非常确定那是枪。

statements.english: - Okay , listen this really hurts . Let's go . - But no !
statements.chinese: - 好吧，听着这话真的很伤人。我们走吧。- 但是不行！

hurts.definition: hurt（第三人称单数）: 伤害

statements.english: A real man wouldn't just run to the hospital
statements.chinese: 真正的男人不会只是跑向医院。

statements.english: No ! What would ... what would Krog do ?
statements.chinese: 不！Krog会...Krog会怎么做？

statements.english: Why isn't that valet back with my Porsche ?
statements.chinese: 那个代客泊车的怎么还没把我的Porsche开回来？

statements.english: Maybe because you've got the keys ?
statements.chinese: 也许是因为钥匙在你手上？

statements.english: That was totally your fault
statements.chinese: 这完全是你的错。

statements.english: My fault ? You threatened the judge
statements.chinese: 我的错？你可是威胁了法官。

statements.english: You ripped the paper out of the court reporter's machine !
statements.chinese: 你把法庭书记员的记录纸从机器里扯出来了！

statements.english: That was the only way l could get him to stop typing !
statements.chinese: 这是唯一能让他停下打字的方法！

statements.english: Hi . How are the Gellers ?
statements.chinese: 嗨，Gellers一家还好吗？

statements.english: Don't call us that
statements.chinese: 别那么称呼我们。

statements.english: The judge wouldn't let us get an annulment
statements.chinese: 法官不同意我们撤销婚姻。

statements.english: Now we gotta get a divorce !
statements.chinese: 现在我们得离婚了！

statements.english: Did a Porsche throw up on you ?
statements.chinese: 你是被一辆保时捷吐了一身吗？

Did.definition: do（过去式）: 构成疑问句
